jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 부속지번 lane `building-register-sub-parcel` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0395): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_register_sub_parcel already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows key bucket by key bucket and append to main only the rows of the registers whose sub-parcel set changed and a removal marker per vanished register (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

assets.title: 건축물대장 부속지번
assets.description: 건물이 함께 선 다른 필지(부속지번)를 대장(관리건축물대장PK)마다 여러 행으로: 대장 대지의 PNU 와 부속 필지의 PNU(sub_pnu) 둘을 싣는다. 건물↔필지 다리다(place-identity, 루트 ADR-0288). 원문 33칸 보존. 읽는 소비자(필지·건물 by-PNU 패널)는 다음 PR 이라 그때까지 섬으로 둔다(루트 ADR-0395).

dependencies.description: 부속지번(mart_djy_05) 33칸을 관리건축물대장PK 마다 바뀐 대장의 행 묶음만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0395).
dependencies.pnu_resolution: pnu and sub_pnu composed at Silver by the Rust hub export (export-*-silver-handoff, standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes / ADR-0145), not a raw provider code; sub_pnu is null where the 시군구 crosswalk refuses a retired code and its raw codes stay for the place-identity resolver at the consumer (ADR-0288, ADR-0395 §3)
